source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, General Information and Lubrication, p.0-9

procedures.title: Engine crankcase oil: capacity and viscosity
steps: Choose oil viscosity for the lowest temperature expected until the next change, not for the temperature on the day of the change.
When changing oil, plan for the temperatures of the next 4 months.

specs.what: add with filter change (6 and 8 cyl.)

notes: Light oils (SAE 5W, 10W) suit cold weather for easy starting; heavier grades (SAE 20, 20W) suit hot weather for oil economy.
Wrong viscosity for a sudden cold snap causes hard starting.
Viscosity numbers describe body only, not other quality factors.
